The '''Ayehe Twi'lek Dance Troupe''' was a dance troupe of ten [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] led by their choreographer, [[Ardana Mitt'Ayehe]]. They were hired to perform at a celebration in honor of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Rodin Hlian Verpalion]] at [[Santhe Mansion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]].
